Hey Darron, just been working on year-end stuff here.  Too many late
nights.  I have been keeping up with recruiting.  The guy from Jersey
Village is Abe Robinson, a  O-lineman, TE prospect.  He will probably play
offenseive tackle (6'5" -260 - 4.9) and is a top 10-15 prospect in the
state.  Texas will have a top 5 recruiting class but the problem is that OU
will possible have the top 1 or 2 class and have signed the top defensive
player in Texas, Tommie Harris.   A&M is the odd man out in the mix because
of the emergence of OU and LSU.   A&M is going back to pre-Sherrill days.
I would think they will be looking for a new coach next year.

Let's try to get together soon.  Maybe have lunch or something.

Talk to you soon
